mapper.sql: select cat_id, archive_no, cat_name, alias, breed, sex, age_estimate, birth_date, birth_estimated, weight, personality, source, capture_date, capture_point, neutered, dewormed, vaccinated, feature, registrar, status, base_id, ward_id, owner_base_id, hospital_name, qr_code, archived, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, (select ifnull(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), u.user_name) from sys_user u where u.user_name = cat_profile.create_by limit 1) as creator_name from cat_profile

select cat_id, archive_no, cat_name, alias, breed, sex, age_estimate, birth_date, birth_estimated, weight, personality, source, capture_date, capture_point, neutered, dewormed, vaccinated, feature, registrar, status, base_id, ward_id, owner_base_id, hospital_name, (case when qr_code is not null and qr_code <> '' then 1 else 0 end) as has_qr_code, archived, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from cat_profile
mapper.select: select t.tag_name from cat_tag t inner join cat_profile_tag pt on pt.tag_id = t.tag_id where pt.cat_id = #{catId} order by t.tag_id
select tag_id from cat_profile_tag where cat_id = #{catId} order by tag_id

select p.cat_id, p.archive_no, p.cat_name, p.sex, p.neutered, p.weight, p.status, p.remark, p.qr_code, b.base_name, w.ward_name, ph.photo_url, ph.photo_folder,
(case when (select count(distinct v.vaccine_type) from cat_vaccine v where v.cat_id = p.cat_id and v.del_flag = '0' and v.vaccine_type in ('第一针', '第二针', '第三针')) >= 3 then '已打齐' else (select concat(ifnull(v.vaccine_type, '疫苗'), ' · ', date_format(v.vaccine_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) from cat_vaccine v where v.cat_id = p.cat_id and v.del_flag = '0' order by v.vaccine_date desc, v.vaccine_id desc limit 1) end) as vaccine_text, coalesce( (select concat(r.hospital_name, ' · ', date_format(r.send_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) from cat_referral r where r.cat_id = p.cat_id and r.del_flag = '0' order by r.send_date desc, r.referral_id desc limit 1), nullif(p.hospital_name, '') ) as hospital_text, (select concat(date_format(d.visit_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), ' ', ifnull(d.diagnosis_result, '')) from cat_diagnosis d where d.cat_id = p.cat_id and d.del_flag = '0' order by d.visit_date desc, d.diagnosis_id desc limit 1) as diagnosis_text
from cat_profile p left join cat_base b on b.base_id = p.base_id left join cat_ward w on w.ward_id = p.ward_id
left join lateral ( select coalesce(nullif(p2.thumb_url, ''), p2.file_url) as photo_url, p2.folder as photo_folder from cat_photo p2 where p2.cat_id = p.cat_id and p2.file_type = '1' order by (case when ifnull(p2.folder, '') = '信息卡' then 1 else 0 end), p2.create_time desc, p2.photo_id desc limit 1 ) ph on true where p.cat_id in #{id}

select pc.cat_id as catId, pc.prescription_id as prescriptionId, pc.start_date as startDate, pc.days as days, pi.drug_name as drugName, pi.dosage as dosage, pi.administration as administration, pi.time_periods as periods, pi.usage_note as usageNote, di.quantity as quantity, di.unit as unit from cat_prescription pc join cat_prescription_item pi on pi.prescription_id = pc.prescription_id
left join cat_diagnosis_item di on di.diagnosis_id = pc.diagnosis_id and di.item_name = pi.drug_name and di.detail_id = (select min(d2.detail_id) from cat_diagnosis_item d2 where d2.diagnosis_id = pc.diagnosis_id and d2.item_name = pi.drug_name) where pc.del_flag = '0' and pc.status = '0' and pc.cat_id in #{id} order by pc.cat_id, pc.prescription_id desc, pi.sort, pi.item_id

select m.cat_id as catId, m.use_date as useDate, m.time_period as timePeriod, m.drug_name as drugName, m.dosage as dosage, m.administration as administration from cat_medication m where m.del_flag = '0' and m.cat_id in #{id} order by m.cat_id, m.use_date desc, m.medication_id desc
mapper.update: update cat_profile set archived = #{archived}, update_time = sysdate() where cat_id = #{catId}
mapper.insert: insert into cat_profile ( archive_no, cat_name, alias, breed, sex, age_estimate, birth_date, birth_estimated, weight, personality, source, capture_date, capture_point, neutered, dewormed, vaccinated, feature, registrar, status, base_id, ward_id, owner_base_id, hospital_name, qr_code, archived, create_by, remark, create_time )values( #{archiveNo}, #{catName}, #{alias}, #{breed}, #{sex}, #{ageEstimate}, #{birthDate}, #{birthEstimated}, #{weight}, #{personality}, #{source}, #{captureDate}, #{capturePoint}, #{neutered}, #{dewormed}, #{vaccinated}, #{feature}, #{registrar}, #{status}, #{baseId}, #{wardId}, #{ownerBaseId}, #{hospitalName}, #{qrCode}, #{archived}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, sysdate() )
mapper.update:
update cat_profile
archive_no = #{archiveNo}, cat_name = #{catName}, alias = #{alias}, breed = #{breed}, sex = #{sex},
age_estimate = #{ageEstimate}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, birth_estimated = #{birthEstimated},
birth_date = null, weight = #{weight},
personality = #{personality}, source = #{source}, capture_date = #{captureDate}, capture_point = #{capturePoint}, neutered = #{neutered}, dewormed = #{dewormed}, vaccinated = #{vaccinated}, feature = #{feature},
registrar = #{registrar}, status = #{status}, base_id = #{baseId}, ward_id = #{wardId}, owner_base_id = #{ownerBaseId},
hospital_name = #{hospitalName}, qr_code = #{qrCode}, archived = #{archived}, update_by = #{updateBy},
remark = #{remark}, update_time = sysdate()
where cat_id = #{catId}
mapper.delete: update cat_profile set del_flag = '2' where cat_id = #{catId}
update cat_profile set del_flag = '2' where cat_id in #{id}
mapper.update: update cat_profile set archived = '1', update_time = sysdate() where cat_id = #{catId}
update cat_profile set ward_id = null, update_time = sysdate() where cat_id = #{catId}
update cat_profile set base_id = null, ward_id = null, update_time = sysdate() where cat_id = #{catId}
update cat_profile set hospital_name = '', update_time = sysdate() where cat_id = #{catId}
mapper.select: select hospital_name from ( select hospital_name from cat_profile where del_flag = '0' and hospital_name is not null and hospital_name <> '' union select hospital_name from cat_referral where del_flag = '0' and hospital_name is not null and hospital_name <> '' ) t order by hospital_name
select distinct breed from cat_profile where del_flag = '0' and breed is not null and breed <> '' order by breed
where del_flag = '0' and birth_date is not null and birth_date <= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{years} year) and (archived is null or archived = '0') order by birth_date

select t.wardId, t.wardName, t.baseId, t.baseName, t.catCount from ( select w.ward_id as wardId, w.ward_name as wardName, w.base_id as baseId, b.base_name as baseName, count(p.cat_id) as catCount, 0 as unassigned, w.order_num as orderNum from cat_ward w left join cat_base b on b.base_id = w.base_id left join cat_profile p on p.ward_id = w.ward_id and p.del_flag = '0' where w.del_flag = '0'
and w.ward_id in #{wid}
and 1 = 0
group by w.ward_id, w.ward_name, w.base_id, b.base_name, w.order_num union all
select null as wardId, '未分配病房' as wardName, null as baseId, null as baseName, count(*) as catCount, 1 as unassigned, 0 as orderNum from cat_profile where del_flag = '0' and ward_id is null and 1 = 0 ) t order by t.unassigned, t.baseName, t.orderNum, t.wardId
